description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for two metrics, MMAU and MMAR, across three models: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The horizontal axis lists the model names in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 0 to 70 in increments of 10, indicating a linear scale. Each model has two adjacent bars: a blue bar representing MMAU and a purple bar representing MMAR. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 50% and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 30%. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 60% and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 35%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 65% and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 55%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model names on the x-axis. There is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar.
